about.title: About Coastal Roofing Specialists
text: Whether you’re facing storm damage, planning a full roof replacement, or just looking for honest guidance, we’re here—ready to listen, ready to help. Schedule your inspection today, and let’s get started.

At Coastal Roofing Specialist LLC, we believe great work begins with great people—and a whole lot of heart. As a veteran-owned, locally operated company based in Friendswood, TX, we’re proud to serve our neighbors with craftsmanship that lasts and relationships that matter.

We’re not here to chase volume. We’re here to raise the standard. Whether it’s roofing, siding, gutters, or fencing, we show up, do it right, and take pride in every detail—because your home deserves nothing less.
